title: 第1章 重生
slug: 极寒末世我有空间囤货躺平
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

末日第104天

林殊被钢绳捆住动弹不得，椅子上的黏腻散发着恶臭。

但她已经麻木了。

因为她被绑在这里67天了。

身体被钢绳捆住固定在椅子上，右手手腕单独吊起来，用铁丝紧紧绑在防盗窗的钢筋上。

她挣脱了很多次，即便手腕已经磨到血肉模糊，还是没有挣脱开这枷锁。

极低的温度，使她的躯体变得僵硬，现在更没有办法逃脱了。

“快，从空间里拿吃的出来！”堂妹林婉儿手里拿着钢管，狠狠抽在林殊的背上。

林殊吃痛，重重闷哼一声。

她知道反抗没有任何用处，顺从地用大拇指捏住食指的红痣，意念一闪，拿出一个馒头来。

林婉儿拿了馒头，转身就走，依偎到母亲身边。

林婉儿的母亲是林殊的婶婶，叫王青梅。

“妈能不能把空间移到我们身上啊，她也太臭了，弄死得了。”林婉儿嚼着馒头，嘴上不满的抱怨。

“哎哟，我的闺女受苦了，忍忍吧宝贝儿，万一弄死了空间不见了可怎么办！吃的可都在她空间里呢！”王青梅拍拍林婉儿的手，眼里全是心疼。

林殊看看那白馒头，咽了咽口水，她极度渴望食物。

她的右手被那群人紧紧的拉到远处绑起来，空间里的东西又恰巧只能落在她的右手边，根本放不进嘴里。

现在只能任人摆布，苟延残喘地活着。

林殊的未婚夫唐哲和叔叔林正从地下管道上来，手里捏着几只老鼠。

“收获不错啊。”林婉儿看着那几只肥大的老鼠，惊喜极了。

“别一次吃完，养着吧。”叔叔林正把手上的老鼠递给王青梅。

“养着？哪有东西喂啊！”王青梅现在就想全部吃完。

“那不是现成的。”林正指了指角落里绑着的林殊。

王青梅秒懂，把老鼠放进笼子里，满脸嫌弃的扯掉林殊的裤子，再将铁笼子放在林殊的腿上。

饥饿的老鼠闻到肉味，低下头，透过笼子的铁丝网，对着林殊的大腿啃食起来。

林殊被那恶心又细小的牙齿啃噬，钻心的痛和致命的恶心感折磨着她。

但她没有任何力气尖叫了。

甚至连抖一抖腿都做不到。

“哈哈哈，看她这让人反胃的样子，真让人受不了。”林婉儿一边做了个恶心的表情，一边又享受地看着林殊脸上的痛苦。

Doomsday Day 104

Lin Shu was tied up with steel ropes and couldn't move, and the stickiness on the chair exuded a foul odor.

But she was numb.

Because she has been tied here for 67 days.

His body was tied and fixed to the chair with steel ropes, and his right wrist was hung up alone and tightly tied to the steel bars of the security window with iron wires.

She broke free many times, but even though her wrists were bruised and bloody, she still couldn't break free of the shackles.

The extremely low temperature made her body stiff, and now there was no way to escape.

"Quickly, get something to eat from the space!" Cousin Lin Wan'er held a steel pipe in her hand and whipped Lin Shu hard on the back.

Lin Shu felt pain and groaned heavily.

She knew that resistance was useless, so she obediently pinched the red mole on her index finger with her thumb, and with a flash of thought, she took out a steamed bun.

Lin Wan'er took the steamed buns, turned around and left, snuggling up to her mother's side.

Lin Wan'er's mother is Lin Shu's aunt, named Wang Qingmei.

"Mom, can you move some space to us? She stinks so much that she could die." Lin Wan'er chewed the steamed buns and complained dissatisfiedly.

"Oh, my daughter is suffering, bear with her, baby, what if she dies and loses her space! All the food is in her space!" Wang Qingmei patted Lin Wan'er's hand, her eyes filled with distress.

Lin Shu looked at the white steamed bun and swallowed. She was eager for food.

Her right hand was tightly pulled far away and tied up by the group of people. The things in the space happened to only fall on her right side and could not be put into her mouth at all.

Now I can only live at the mercy of others and survive.

Lin Shu's fiancé Tang Zhe and uncle Lin Zheng came up from the underground pipe, holding several mice in their hands.

"The harvest is good." Lin Wan'er looked at the fat mice and was extremely pleasantly surprised.

"Don't eat it all at once, keep it." Uncle Lin Zheng handed the mouse to Wang Qingmei.

"Keep it up? Where can I find anything to feed it!" Wang Qingmei wants to eat it all right now.

"That's not ready-made." Lin Zheng pointed to Lin Shu who was tied up in the corner.

Wang Qingmei understood instantly, put the mouse into the cage, pulled off Lin Shu's pants with a look of disgust, and then placed the iron cage on Lin Shu's legs.

The hungry mouse smelled the meat, lowered its head, and gnawed at Lin Shu's thigh through the wire mesh of the cage.

Lin Shu was bitten by those disgusting and tiny teeth, and the heartbreaking pain and fatal nausea tormented her.

But she didn't have any strength left to scream.

I couldn't even shake my legs.

"Hahaha, it's really unbearable to see how disgusting she is." Lin Wan'er made a disgusting expression while looking at the pain on Lin Shu's face with enjoyment.
